name: Raging Rubble
body:
An area of rubble, gravel, and small stones animates, creating a dangerous, rolling area of debris.

Raging Rubble
CR 2

XP 600
N Small construct
Init +0; Senses darkvision 60 ft., low-light vision; Perception –5

DEFENSE

AC 17, touch 14, flat-footed 17 (+3 natural, +4 size)
hp 26 (3d10+10)
Fort +1, Ref +1, Will -4
Defensive Abilities hardness 8; Immune construct traits, swarm traits (small swarm creatures are not immune to weapon damage)
Weaknesses swarm traits

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee swarm (1d6)
Space 10 ft.; Reach 0 ft.
Special Attacks distraction (DC 12)

STATISTICS

Str 10, Dex 10, Con —, Int —, Wis 1, Cha 1
Base Atk +2; CMB –; CMD —
SQ construction points (stone, swarm), flaw (young simple template)

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Construction Points

This animated object has two construction points.

Editor’s Note

This creature is based on the description in the spell Raging Rubble. It takes a medium animated object and applies the young simple creature template. One construct point was spent on stone, while the second was considered the swarm ability.

Created by: Brett, d20pfsrd Beastmaster I

ECOLOGY

Environment any
Organization solitary, pair, or group (3-12)
Treasure Value none
